decisions.reason: The source also applies to the main board through message 506 context, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing the bottom-side connector policy.
This requirement concerns battery-connector placement on the power board, while the source context concerns connector accessibility on the vertically mounted main and sensor boards.
The source decision is bounded by the preceding discussion of the main and sensor boards and does not change the power-board mechanical layout.
Minimizing bottom-side connector placement does not alter the specified connector types, pinouts, topology, or matching interboard interface semantics.
The connector inventory and electrical interfaces remain unchanged; physical placement is already owned by the sensor-board mechanical-layout requirement.
The mechanical connector-placement policy does not change current-monitoring rails, coverage, channels, or monitor placement.
The source does not change the SPS30 SEL-to-GND connection or its I2C mode.
Connector accessibility does not alter the I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal-conditioning requirements.
The source concerns physical connector placement and does not change standalone USB power capacity, activation, load coverage, or source selection.

The source does not specifically relocate or otherwise change the panel power-button connector; applying the general placement preference to this connector requires no change to the candidate's recorded functional state.
The source does not change the BOOT control, reset connection, or associated capacitance values.
The connector-placement policy does not change the selected ESP32-S3 module or establish a modification to this requirement.
